items.title: Albert Nicholas Interview, 1972-06-26
items.q: Yeah, but I know she was a big one. She had a sound. She could sing. Ada Brown, that's her.

ctx.x: I think she was James Scott's cousin. You know the guy that wrote Climax Rag and all that.
What? Yeah, but I know she was a big one. She had a sound. She could sing. Ada Brown, that's her. I think she did, man.
She made Panama Limited and all that. She had a sound, man.
